app-templates.message:
feat(quiz): Naturwunder-Quiz zeigt Bilder aus Wikipedia

## Intent

Questions can now carry images, so the Naturwunder-Quiz should show one at every question, taken from the Wikipedia article behind the answer. Every image names its source, its licence and its author, and must not give the answer away.

## Key changes

- Seven of the eight questions show an image from Wikimedia Commons between the question and the answers. Each image comes from the article of the answer and is freely licensed.
- The source is the Commons page as a link, the licence is shown below the image, and the caption ends with the author ("Foto: Name."). The caption says what to look at, without the answer.
- weltnaturerbe has no image, because any photo of one option would mark it as right or wrong. Questions with several articles show one image of the first article.
- The images are stored in the quiz's image folder, at most 960 px wide.
- The question bank is formatted as the quiz's own check wants, and the architecture check leaves the image folder to the question bank.
